summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Andraemon the husband of Dryope in Ovid's telling and of other figures who bear the name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Andraemon among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Lamas and before Agerochus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
